verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents SSH access to instances using key-only authentication, and it can manage SSH keys. Community evidence says renters get a full Linux shell, and users can override the image entrypoint and open custom ports, which implies broad control of the environment. Root access, however, is never stated explicitly. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of root/sudo privileges inside the instance, and first-party detail on how users upload their own public keys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment

citations.quote: Vast.ai instances are configured to accept keys only - Password authentication is disabled for improved security.
